title: Geometry and density design slabs run the streamed adjoint without a full 3D epsilon or VJP on the device or the host, and the host budget counts the design tensor and the optimizer moments

fixture.region: 3D, 800 x 32 x 32 cells at 0.05 um (40 x 1.6 x 1.6 um), 4 CPML cells (geometry: on every face; density: periodic x and y, CPML z), Yee sampling, FP32, 10 steps, memory_mode streamed
fixture.geometry: public synthetic solids of torchfdtd.streamed_geometry: a box 0.9 x 0.9 x 0.5 um rotated 20 degrees about z with epsilon p0 = 3.1 and centre (p1, 0, 0) = (0.1, 0, 0) um, and a sphere of radius p2 = 0.4 um, epsilon 2.4, at (-0.6, 0.2, 0.1) um; background 1; chunk_cells 65536; three differentiable parameters
fixture.density: 16 x 8 periodic density layer (torchfdtd.streamed_density_layer) between z = -0.2 and 0.2 um, background epsilon 1, design epsilon 4, cell-edge pixel origin, values from torch.rand with seed 3; 128 differentiable parameters
fixture.source_and_monitor: Ez point source at (0, 0, -0.1) um, standard Gaussian pulse (0.8 um, FWHM 0.5 fs, centre 0.5 fs, amplitude 100); one Ez probe at (0, 0, 0.1) um; objective sum of squared time signals
fixture.policy: StreamedAdjointOptions(device=cuda, slab_width=8, temporal_depth=5, checkpoints=0, gpu_budget_bytes=9600000, host_budget_bytes=8 GiB, state_storage=disk (private scratch, disk_budget_bytes 2 GiB), tile_transfers=sync)
fixture.full_epsilon: the diagonal Yee-sampled FP32 material of the whole grid: 800*32*32*3*4 = 9,830,400 bytes, larger than the declared GPU budget of 9,600,000 bytes, so a path that materialized it on the device could not be admitted or would exceed its budget
fixture.instruments: report['forward_memory'] and report['backward_memory'] peak_torch_allocated_bytes.delta_bytes (exact allocator peak after torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats), the AllocationTrace TorchDispatchMode of tests/test_streamed_geometry.py listing every host tensor allocation with its shape and storage bytes (disk banks keep the field state out of host tensors), report['dense_material_storage_bytes'], report['dense_material_vjp_bytes'], report['design_tensor_bytes'], report['optimizer_state_reservation_bytes']
fixture.budget_checks: torchfdtd/streamed.py::_reservation adds optimizer_moments * design_tensor_bytes to the host reservation for the dense, dispersive, geometry and density paths; estimate_streamed_memory, plan_streamed_work and the run report carry the same fields; Adam's exp_avg and exp_avg_sq of a leaf of the geometry packet's shape are compared with the declared two moments

reference_method: a size bound, not a physics oracle: the byte size of the full diagonal epsilon array computed from the grid shape, and the parameter tensor sizes computed from their shapes; the design-slab physics itself is verified against the dense material in tests/test_streamed_geometry.py and tests/test_streamed_density.py

observables.name: peak_torch_allocated_delta_bytes
observables.definition: max over the forward and backward phases of the exact Torch allocator peak minus the bytes allocated when the phase began

observables.name: full_shape_host_allocations
observables.definition: host tensor allocations with shape (800,32,32), (800,32,32,3) or (800,32,32,1) and storage above 4 bytes during the run and its backward

observables.name: max_host_allocation_bytes
observables.definition: largest host tensor storage allocated during the run

observables.name: gradient_max_abs
observables.definition: largest gradient magnitude of the design parameters, which must be finite and nonzero so that the VJP path really ran

acceptance.device_rule: for both paths the exact peak Torch allocated delta is below full_epsilon_bytes and at most gpu_budget_bytes, and gpu_reservation_bytes is at most gpu_budget_bytes
acceptance.host_rule: full_shape_host_allocations == 0; dense_material_storage_bytes == 0 and dense_material_vjp_bytes == 0 in the report; the gradient is finite and nonzero
acceptance.budget_rule: for the dense path (_reservation, estimate_streamed_memory, plan_streamed_work, the run report) and the geometry and density executions, host_reservation_bytes with optimizer_moments = k minus host_reservation_bytes with 0 moments equals exactly k * design_tensor_bytes for k in {1, 2}, gpu_reservation_bytes is unchanged, design_tensor_bytes equals the parameter tensor's numel times element size, the dense parameter reservation is an integer multiple (at least one) of it, a budget equal to the moment-free reservation refuses the run with moments, and the declared two moments equal the byte size of Adam's two state tensors
acceptance.source_of_limits: G5-04 specification: no full 3D epsilon/VJP in the geometry/density slab paths, the CPU design tensor and optimizer state reflected in the memory budget; the size bound is the array size itself and no numeric tolerance applies

not_yet_covered: host-bank runs of the design paths under the AllocationTrace: with host banks the E and H field banks are legitimately full-shape host tensors, so the host check is made with disk banks and the device check covers both
a design tensor held on a CUDA device (the streamed design paths take CPU parameters by contract)

notes: Declared before the recorded run on branch g5-memory from main 73203d2. A prototype at this commit measured a peak Torch allocated delta of 3,825,664 bytes (0.41 of the full epsilon) for the geometry path on 768 x 32 x 32 cells with a 10 MiB budget; the recorded fixture uses 800 x 32 x 32 cells so that the full epsilon exceeds the budget while the tile reservation (9,437,300 bytes) still fits. The record is docs/validation/g5/G5-04.json.
